name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional rule, so the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) is the right template and order. It forbids reaching the exit before the first toggle and adds no goal the task does not state. Rule-only with an empty FINAL_STATES is valid here.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, it must have toggled the switch at an earlier step: the exit cannot be reached before the first toggle.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
